newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schenker invests more in info technology.
newsitem.headline: Schenker invests more in info technology.

text.p: Global forwarder Schenker International will increase investment in information technology to improve its competitive position, parent company Stinnes AG said.
Stinnes chairman Helmut Mamsch said information technology was the key to improving Schenker International's services and efficiency but did not give further details.
Some 90 clients were already connected to Sword, the forwarder's in-house Intranet, he added at a news briefing.
Schenker International will also open a logistics centre in Singapore to take advantage of dynamic economic growth in Asia, he added.
